question: Find a single discount (approximately) equal to three consecutive discounts of 11%, 12% and 2%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For consecutive discounts, use the successive formula: D = a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100.

Combine the first two discounts (11% and 12%):

D₁ = 11 + 12 − (11 × 12) ÷ 100 = 23 − 1.32 = 21.68%.

Now, combine the result (21.68%) with the third discount (2%):

D₂ = 21.68 + 2 − (21.68 × 2) ÷ 100 = 23.68 − 0.4336 = 23.2464% ≈ 23.25%.

**∴ The correct answer is 23.25%.**
